name: Nesiah
title: Descendant of Adonikam
summary: Nesiah (also known as Nesha) is a person mentioned in the book of Ezra as one of the descendants who returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He is listed among those who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylon to Judah. His role was primarily as part of the Jewish people's return and the rebuilding of society in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Nesiah was among those who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile under the leadership of Zerubbabel and Joshua.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Temple Servants
keyEvents.description: Nesiah is mentioned among the Nethinim (temple servants) who returned to Jerusalem, indicating his connection to service in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem and Surrounding Areas
keyEvents.description: After the return, the temple servants, including Nesiah's descendants, settled in Jerusalem and nearby cities to resume their service.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Community
keyEvents.description: As part of the returning exiles, Nesiah's family contributed to the rebuilding of the religious and social community in Judah.
